text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Wonder Acute established a rock-solid, steadfast track record.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And furthermore—she maintained a solid and unshakable record over the next 3 years as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And furthermore—over the next 3 years as well—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “Are you immortal??? Acute-san!????”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What would that be about,
Rickey-chan?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's weird! She's been racing
since years before I even debuted, yet..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: To think that even after I've become a full-fledged Senior, you're still running right on the front lines, completely unchanged!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's true. The reason I'm doing well is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It must be thanks to eating this.
How about it, Rickey-chan? Why don't you have some too?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nukazuke... It might be a food for longevity,
but that alone doesn't explain...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"There, there, Rickey. Acute is, you know,
a legend after all."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"You know how it is, right? Even in idol groups,
there's always someone who stays sharp and shines forever."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Is that how it is? Hmm, racing is
a sport, so I don't think it'll go
that easily, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series' Dirt route.
After several years, the faces here have completely changed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae, who became a magnificent ace.
And Copano Rickey, who blossomed brilliantly from a rising star to a rival champion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many other Umamusume made their debuts, and some walked away.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute alone continues to run without changing in the slightest.
As if the passage of time means nothing to her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"You know... Ever since right after my debut,
people have been saying I act like an old lady, right?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So even when I become an old grandma,
not a thing will change, you know?
Not a single thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I kind of get it, but kind of don't...
Just how Wonder Acute has changed over time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Judging from what the past dirt Umamusume
who ran alongside her have said—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could you tell me
a little bit about Wonder Acute?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san? Ahaha☆
To me, she's like
a super cute little sister, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A little sister who acts like a grandma? And then
a girl who runs properly anytime, anywhere☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Even when it's not televised on TV♪
I've never seen her slack off."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume F
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my junior Falco was doting on her, wasn't she?
Even though she was a newcomer who acted like an old lady, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume F
text_block_list.text:
In races... she wasn't someone to underestimate, huh.
She always showed her true strength without fail...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text: I used to talk about it a lot with my classmate Falco. About how an interesting junior had joined us.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume E
text_block_list.text:
She's strangely philosophical about it... Either way, her
running form never breaks down. She's always so composed.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume T
text_block_list.text: We're actually the same age. At first, I was like, 'Why does my classmate talk like an old lady...?'

text_block_list.name: Umamusume T
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like she's always supported our generation.
Like a role model who always gives her all in every run."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
They take such good care of me!
Plus, if it's just Ricky and me running together,
she gets lonely!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, in feng shui, the interpretation is that
monsters and spirits don't exist, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see that unchanging dedication,
I sometimes wonder...
if she might be the incarnation of some kind of spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—No matter which generation I asked, the impression was always the same.
That she was “like a grandmother.”
And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To always run properly, anytime, anywhere."
That stance has remained completely unchanged over all these years.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is it really that strange to you?
That I can just keep on running forever.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's just... everyone else doesn't know about that. So...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's right. That thing my Trainer does for me before a race. You know, that smack-whack on the shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've received so many warm feelings from that.
For so many years now...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can stay so energetic.
Thanks to that, I can stay true to myself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: The things I've received from Trainer... are already countless, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—All the feelings poured into this routine.
When I first debuted, it was just about pumping
myself up. But now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Its meaning changed as the years went by. Sometimes a slightly firmer massage, sometimes a prayer for a safe return home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She always poured something different into that same act.
Whatever Wonder Acute was seeking the most.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps, banter like that is one of the secrets to staying active for so long. And—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Kashiwa Kinen, isn't it?
The fans might think a GⅠ is a bit much, though~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"How should I know? As if anyone could.
I've got things that only belong to me."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer, shall we get going!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The curtains rise on a new race once more.
A new chapter in a never-ending story.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eras are passed down.
From Umamusume who depart to new Umamusume who arrive.
The story is constantly inherited. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute won't pass the torch. She will keep running forever, carrying the history of dirt racing upon her back.
